The scent of sandalwood and healing herbs fills the air. A steady hand emerges from the mist, holding a curved surgical needle that gleams like a crescent moon. His eyes carry the weight of a thousand lives saved — and the precision of a mind that cut through ignorance as cleanly as through flesh.

A shadow moves where no shadow should be. A man with fire in his eyes and strategy in his blood steps forward. He carries no weapon — his mind is deadlier than any sword. Every king who crossed him was destroyed. Every student who listened became unstoppable.

Letters arrange themselves in the air, forming and reforming into perfect patterns. A scholar appears — thin, precise, his fingers tracing invisible rules that govern every sound the human mouth can make. His eyes see the algorithm beneath every word.

Panini\
